title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten documented, student-accessible activities with no purchase or admission required.

cards.title: Play pool at J. Lee’s
cards.subtitle: Student Center Annex, SC-226
cards.notes: Bring a few classmates to the Student Center Annex lounge and use the pool table during J. Lee’s posted open hours.
cards.short_summary: A student-lounge pool game with no purchase required.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists access to J. Lee’s pool tables among its services for the student activities lounge.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.title: Set up a ping-pong game
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Use the lounge’s ping-pong tables for a low-key group game, then return equipment as directed by the attendant.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost table-tennis hang in the student lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists access to ping-pong tables among J. Lee’s student-lounge services.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.title: Choose a board game
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Meet at J. Lee’s, pick from the available board games, and keep the group session within the lounge’s operating hours.
cards.short_summary: Board-game time using the lounge’s provided games.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo identifies board games as a service available in J. Lee’s.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.entity_name: Wide-screen TV viewing at J. Lee’s
cards.title: Watch something together
cards.subtitle: J. Lee’s, Student Center Annex
cards.notes: Use J. Lee’s wide-screen televisions for a shared viewing break, and check with the lounge attendant about current setup.
cards.short_summary: A communal TV break in a student activities lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says J. Lee’s is equipped with wide-screen televisions and audio-video equipment.
cards.source_title: Center for Student Involvement — J. Lee’s
cards.access_notes: Student lounge; use during J. Lee’s posted open hours.

cards.entity_name: Yoga-mat relaxation in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Reserve a yoga-mat reset
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve a 30-minute small-group appointment, sign out the key from CSI, and use the yoga mats for a quiet reset.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Room has yoga mats, permits up to six students per reservation, and is available to students for free.
cards.access_notes: Students reserve appointments; up to five other students may join one reservation.

cards.entity_name: Light therapy in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Try the light therapy lamp
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Book the Wellness Room with friends, sign out the key at CSI, and use the listed light therapy lamp during the reservation.
cards.short_summary: A free reservable relaxation session with light therapy.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists a light therapy lamp in the Wellness Room and states that the room is free for students.
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; appointments are 30 minutes long.

cards.entity_name: Weighted-blanket break in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Take a weighted-blanket break
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve the room for a calm small-group break and use the weighted blanket as part of its listed relaxation resources.
cards.short_summary: A no-cost, reservable decompression break for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellness Room includes a weighted blanket and is available to Ramapo students for free.
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; up to six students total may attend.

cards.entity_name: Massage chair in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Reserve time with the massage chair
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Coordinate a Wellness Room appointment, pick up the key from CSI, and take turns using the room’s massage chair.
cards.short_summary: A free student wellness-room session with a massage chair.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo lists a massage chair in the Wellness Room and says the room is free for students.
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; follow the key sign-out and return procedure.

cards.entity_name: Coloring activities in the Ramapo Wellness Room
cards.title: Make time for coloring
cards.subtitle: Ramapo Wellness Room, E-216
cards.notes: Reserve the room with a few friends and use its available coloring activities for a slower, screen-free group break.
cards.short_summary: A screen-free wellness-room activity with no fee.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo states that coloring activities are available in the Wellness Room, which is free for students.
cards.access_notes: Student reservation required; check the current reservation calendar.

cards.title: Join a Togetherall group
cards.subtitle: Online peer-support platform for Ramapo students
cards.notes: Create an account through Ramapo’s Togetherall access, then join a topic-based group or respond supportively to another post.
cards.short_summary: An anonymous online group space available at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Ramapo says Togetherall is completely free, anonymous, and lets users join topic-based groups.
cards.access_notes: Online service for Ramapo students; anonymous and monitored by mental-health professionals.
